verdicts.title: Complex Monopoles in the Path Integral
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: Complex monopole configurations dominate in the path integral in the Georgi-Glashow-Chern-Simons model and disorder the Higgs vacuum. No cancellation is expected among Gribov copies of the monopole configurations.
